- [ES2006a:15:38] They will sell the remotes for twenty five Euros each.
- [ES2006a:15:44] They will aim for a profit of fifty million Euros.
- [ES2006a:15:52] The remotes will target the international market.
- [ES2006c:29:05] The remote control and its buttons will be made of rubber. (replaces a wooden case)
- [ES2006c:28:46] The case will be flat on top and curved on the bottom.
- [ES2006c:34:15] The remote will have push buttons outside, and an LCD and spinning wheel inside.
- [ES2006c:30:22] The remote will resemble a vegetable and be in bright vegetable colors.
- [ES2006c:33:24] It will have voice recognition, use a simple battery, and contain an advanced chip. (replaces a simple chip)
- [ES2006c:26:48] It will have standard on/off, channel-changing, numerical, and volume buttons, with a menu on the screen.
